status.role: watches the ruins children while Ariel and Sophis visit the New Kingdom

periods.summary: Child leader at the Seventh Ruins Moon. She and the other rescued children call Ariel and Sophis their mothers and send them off cheerfully.

ariel-vi-arcadia.summary: Calls her mother and is cared for by her.

sophis-excelf.summary: Also calls her mother despite Sophis's embarrassment.

key_events.summary: Sees Ariel and Sophis off from the Moon ruins at the epilogue's opening.
